subject: QBR + Roadmap demo — narrowed availability & seat allocations
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@polarishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR + Roadmap demo — proposed windows and agenda

Hi Lydia,

Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation last week. As we start locking in the QBR + roadmap demo for Polaris, I wanted to propose a few concrete windows that will work for our team and accommodate your execs.

Proposed formats:
- 90-minute condensed walk-through (exec + product highlights)
- Half-day workshop (90m demo + 60m deep technical Q&A / migration planning)

Available windows (Pacific time):
- Wed Sep 22: 08:30–10:00 or 13:00–16:00
- Thu Sep 23: 09:00–11:30 or 14:00–17:00

Attachments: QBR-agenda-v2.pdf (draft agenda) — please skim and tell me which format you prefer and who from Polaris needs to attend (execs, security, infra). If none of the windows work, share a couple of times and we'll trade seats on our side.

Quick ask: we typically lock exec presence by EOD Friday — would that timeline work on your side?

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachments: QBR-agenda-v2.pdf (17KB)
From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@polarishealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Alex Soto <alex.soto@polarishealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap demo — proposed windows and agenda

Hi Naomi — thanks for the options and the agenda. Short answers first: we want the half-day workshop so we can bring engineering and procurement stakeholders.

Conflicts: our exec (Dr. Patel) is out Wed morning, Thu morning is tight because of our all-hands. The best options for us are:
- Thu Sep 23 afternoon (14:00–17:00 PT) — preferred
- Fri Sep 24 morning (08:30–11:30 PT) — acceptable

I attached our availability matrix as a quick CSV — hope that helps. Also: we'll need an item covering drive-level encryption and auditing (15–20 minutes in the tech section).

Can you confirm who from Redwood will present the migration/fallback runbook? I'll flag that with our infra lead.

Appreciate it,
Lydia
Lydia Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships — Polaris Health
lydia.chen@polarishealth.com

Attachments: polaris-availability.csv (5KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@polarishealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: David Kim <david@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR + Roadmap demo — proposed windows and agenda

Thanks Lydia — Marissa here (replacements + logistics). We can absolutely do Thu Sep 23 14:00–17:00 PT for a half-day workshop. Naomi, David and I will split the session:

- 14:00–14:20: Exec overview + renewal highlights (Naomi)
- 14:20–15:20: Roadmap + feature demo (Marissa)
- 15:20–15:35: break
- 15:35–16:30: Technical deep dive (David) — include audit/KMS content
- 16:30–17:00: Migration/runbook Q&A and next steps (David + Naomi)

David will cover drive-level encryption and audit logging — @David, I've asked him to bring the runbook draft and a short ops checklist.

Naomi — I'll send the calendar invite once Lydia confirms attendee list. Lydia — could you share the final guest list (names + roles) by EOD Thu so we can finalize materials and seat allocations? We have limited exec seats in the preferred room; if there are more than 6 execs we may need to split into two concurrent streams (exec & tech).

Thanks — looking forward.
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference.com

Lydia — thanks, Thu Sep 23 14:00–17:00 PT is locked on our side.

A couple of operational notes before we finalize:
- Please confirm the attendee list with roles (exec / infra / procurement) by EOD Thu 9/16 so we can reserve the exec stream.
- We'll include a 20-minute segment on drive-level encryption, key management, and audit exports. I'll bring the runbook draft and a short ops checklist (qbr-runbook.xlsx).
- If procurement intends to discuss commercial terms or renewal cadence, flag me and Naomi; we can carve out a 15-minute procurement touch at the end.

Naomi — can you add a slide that summarizes the committed SLAs and any outstanding procurement asks we need from Polaris? I'll prep the technical appendix and the DocuSign bundle if procurement confirms.

Lydia — once we have attendee names I'll send a calendar invite (with dial-in + recording consent) and the final agenda.

Best,
David
David Kim
Director, Solutions Architecture — Redwood Inference
david@redwood.inference.com
